conclusion_review.notes: The narrow Stage C inconclusive conclusion is supportable with these qualifications. fact_1 is corroborated by support2 objective countdown/unlock with 0-0 control and tank sampled CONTESTED. fact_2 is corroborated by reciprocal save text, including original 10.0 full-size checks. fact_3 is corroborated by running camera into the side room, reload, nearby enemy Mauga, STUNNED text and resumed firing; movement intent and stun source remain unknown. fact_4 is corroborated by tank zero-health/death HUD and the ALPHARI-to-ROXY feed in all four surviving POVs, including direct original 17.5 checks. Tank alive at 17.0 and dead before 17.5 brackets death without inventing exact timing. Supplementary original 17.95 stills show continuing combat, with ROXY dead and the other four POV players alive at those instants; no fight winner or capture is established. These are consistent with the original source reports and Stage B/C stated uncertainties. No mutually exclusive factual contradiction or unsupported affirmative responsibility claim was found in the checked sampled basis. No adverse finding exists. Each of the five qualified checks supports only no_supported_mistake as evidence insufficiency; safe routes, continuous healing, shot output, ability causes and player foreknowledge are not silently inferred. PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS permits publication of this explicitly inconclusive assessment with all upstream and D limitations; it does not clear the pending human audit or approve a later blame finding.

limitations: D review consists of sampled stills, not continuous playback: all 27 indexed clips were opened through ffmpeg extraction and all 133 displayed clip samples were visually inspected using functions.view_image. Approximately half-second gaps, the last approximately 40 ms per clip, and exact interval endpoint frames are not certified. See inspection_log.json for actual requested sample times; decoding selects a nearby available frame.

Each contact-sheet frame was scaled to at most 640x362. Original tank 10.0 and 15.0 frames were additionally viewed at 1280x724; original support2 10.0 was viewed with tool resizing from 2188x1236 to 2048x1157. Small HUD text, effects, cover and overlapping actors restrict attribution.

Supplementary original-video stills at 17.5 and 17.95 seconds were inspected for all five POVs, scaled to 640x362. ROXY remains dead; the other four POV players are alive at these sampled instants and combat continues. KANEKI health is 71, PINEAPPLE 150, MEWTWO 225 and MMONK 225 at the requested 17.95 samples. These observations do not cover intervening activity, exactly 18.0, subsequent fight outcome or earlier full team counts.

Clip bytes and all five original-video bytes independently matched their supplied SHA-256 hashes. Hash matching establishes byte identity, not synchronization, semantic accuracy or full decode integrity. Pre-alignment and the original-video zero point remain assumed; no offset conversion was applied.

No audio or communications were inspected; the manifest reports no audio tracks. Native player knowledge, attention, intent, calls and access to observer outlines/roster/critical markers remain unknown.

PINEAPPLE hero and exact map remain unknown in this audit. Exact damage/healing sources, shot impacts, protection recipients, save trigger, temporary additional-health sources, KANEKI elevation mechanism, support1 cooldown effect and stun cause/duration are unresolved. Nearby Mauga identity is not interchangeable with ALPHARI elimination credit.

All five Stage C findings are not_established, with no primary, secondary or shared adverse finding. Qualified checks support only insufficient evidence for responsibility. They do not establish flawless play, exhaustive absence of mistakes, optimal allocation or unavailable counterfactual actions. No tactical responsibility percentage or calibrated probability is assigned.
